name: Same-day delivery: missing or substituted item

steps.name: Look up delivery order
steps.instruction: Confirm fulfilment method, partner, who picked, substitution setting and the line items.

steps.name: Identify the affected line
steps.instruction: Which item is missing or substituted; when the member noticed.

steps.name: Apply delivery rules
steps.instruction: Missing item: refund. Substitution: depends on the member's substitution setting.

steps.name: Fault and remedy
steps.instruction: Fault follows who picked the order.

steps.name: PDP
steps.instruction: Authorize the refund against the auto-approve limit.

steps.name: Member confirms terms
steps.instruction: Terms hash confirmed by the member or their agent.

steps.name: BJ's issues refund
steps.instruction: Refund to original payment via BJ's order service.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Partner pick accuracy and substitution compliance logged.

name: Damaged or spoiled perishable or bulk goods

steps.name: Look up order
steps.instruction: Pickup or delivery date starts the window.

steps.name: Evidence and timing
steps.instruction: When noticed; photo if reported after 72 hours.

steps.name: Apply grocery rules
steps.instruction: 90-day grocery window; house-brand money-back guarantee.

steps.name: PDP
steps.instruction: Authorize refund.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Shrink disposition and cause attribution.

name: Pickup not ready, partial or cancelled

steps.name: Look up pickup order
steps.instruction: Scheduled time, ready time, fee charged, items picked up.

steps.name: Apply pickup rules
steps.instruction: Hold window, handling fee, fee refund practice.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Pick-rate scorecard.

name: Coupon not applied or price adjustment

steps.name: Look up receipt and clipped coupons
steps.instruction: Was the coupon clipped before purchase and valid on the item?

steps.name: Apply coupon and price rules
steps.instruction: No published general price-adjustment policy: anything outside the TV price match escalates to a person.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Coupon failure reported with coupon id.

steps.name: Look up membership
steps.instruction: Tier, fee, renewal date, Easy Renewal, prior fee refunds.

steps.name: Does the member want to cancel?
steps.instruction: State what ends with the membership before they decide.

steps.name: Apply money-back guarantee
steps.instruction: First cancellation: refund; later ones: no refund.

steps.name: Member confirms terms
steps.instruction: Confirmation closes the membership.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Retention and win-back flag.

steps.name: Look up purchase
steps.instruction: Purchase/pickup/delivery date, category window, final-sale flags.

steps.name: Apply return windows
steps.instruction: 365 days general; 90 electronics; 30 home; final-sale list.

steps.name: BJ's opens the return
steps.instruction: In-club return with receipt.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Disposition at the club.

name: Agent-placed order: quantity or pack-size error

steps.name: Look up order and Umpyr Check record
steps.instruction: Placed by which agent; what Check decided; who answered the step-up.

steps.name: What was intended vs received
steps.instruction: Units intended, units received, how many cases the member keeps.

steps.name: Bulk final-sale clause vs agent mismatch
steps.instruction: Member-confirmed bulk buy is final sale; platform-confirmed mismatch is the agent's.

steps.name: PDP
steps.instruction: Large refunds queue for BJ's staff.

steps.name: Member confirms terms
steps.instruction: The member, not the agent, confirms the settlement.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Restock; feed agent drift to Check.

steps.name: Look up charges
steps.instruction: Count posted captures and pending holds for the order.

steps.name: Age of the hold
steps.instruction: When did the pending line appear?

steps.name: Apply payment rules
steps.instruction: Holds are explained; true duplicates are reversed.

steps.name: BJ's reverses duplicate
steps.instruction: Through the processor to the original card.

steps.name: Lifecycle closure
steps.instruction: Reconciliation log.
